pyhead.py.summary: Print the first kilobyte of a file.
details: Reads the file as UTF-8 (ignoring decode errors) and prints the first 1024 characters, falling back to a binary read when the text mode fails.

pyjcal.py.summary: Print a Jalali (Persian) calendar, or convert a date to Jalali.
details: Without arguments the current month is rendered as a calendar grid; ``jdate`` prints today's Jalali date and accepts a format string (``-f``), a language (``-l``) and an explicit Gregorian date to convert. The date arithmetic lives in the ``JalaliDate``/``JalaliCalendar``/``JalaliDateFormatter`` classes.

pylychee.py.summary: Check the links of Markdown and HTML files and inline local images.
details: Collects the ``href``/``src`` references and Markdown links, resolves the local ones against the file system, verifies the remote ones with a short HTTP request (8 s timeout) and can rewrite local images as data URIs. Files are scanned in parallel from the given root.

pypi_stats.py.summary: Query the pypistats.org API from the command line.
details: Provides the ``recent`` and ``overall`` subcommands with the usual filters (package, period, date range), prints the numbers as a table, JSON, CSVs or a pandas frame and caches the API responses in the user cache directory. ``-V`` prints the version.
pypi_stats.py.usage: pypi_stats recent PACKAGE | overall PACKAGE [--format json|markdown|rst|csv|tsv|pandas]

pyrgb.py.summary: Browse the RGB/256-colour palette in an interactive terminal grid.
details: Draws a paged grid of colour cells with their codes, let the arrow keys/page keys move around and prints the selected colour values; ``--demo`` cycles through the palette automatically.

pyruf.py.summary: Run ``ruff`` over the Python files below the current directory.
details: Includes the extension-less files whose first line looks like a Python script, skips binaries and caches, and invokes ``ruff check`` (optionally with the arguments given on the command line).

pysanity-check.py.summary: Verify that installed packages import and compare their versions with PyPI.
details: Lists the installed distributions, tries to import each one, asks the PyPI JSON API for the latest release and prints the packages that fail to import or are outdated, with a summary count.

pysearch.py.summary: Search names, file names, contents and archives from one CLI.
details: Subcommands: ``names`` finds person names inside files, ``fast`` walks a tree quickly, ``find`` matches file names including archive members (zip, wheels, tarballs, 7z, zstd, brotli), ``grep`` is a ripgrep-like content search with regex/fixed-string/ignore-case options, ``info`` reports file-name statistics and similar-name groups and ``regex`` builds a regex from a name list.

pyshuf.py.summary: Shuffle the lines of a text file with several strategies.
details: ``--methods`` selects the shuffles (regular, the three-pass fisher-yates style variant, and a weighted shuffle), ``--repeats`` runs several passes and ``--test`` measures how random the output is. Large files are handled through an mmap of the line offsets.

pysim.py.summary: Find Python files with similar definitions by hashing their AST nodes.
details: Extracts the functions and classes of each file, hashes the normalized syntax trees and compares the resulting sets pairwise, printing the files whose definitions overlap and the similarity they share.

pysplit.py.summary: Split a text file into a fixed number of parts.
details: Divides the lines evenly (the last part takes the remainder), writes ``<name>_01.txt``-style parts with zero-padded indexes and refuses binary files.

pyzpkg.py.summary: Zip an installed package and install a loader stub for it.
details: Locates the package in the user ``site-packages``, copies its files into a ``.zip`` (compiling them first when possible), removes the original directory and writes a loader stub so the import still resolves through the archive.
pyzpkg.py.notes: Modifies the installed package in place; keep a backup of ``site-packages``.

quickview.py.summary: Browse the files of the current directory with a curses preview.
details: Lists the directory in a curses window, shows the first 20 lines of the highlighted file and lets you move with the arrow keys and quit with ``q``.

random_font.py.summary: Pick a random font from ``/sdcard/font`` and set it as the Termux font.
details: Chooses a ``.woff2`` file larger than 400 KB without ``italic`` in its name, converts it with fontTools (the decompressed ``.ttf`` already lying next to it is reused) and installs it as ``~/.termux/font.ttf``.
